comment: Independent timeout.c run_timers() witness for a buried glob holding two timers. A levitating Valkyrie drops a wished glob into a wished pool, then fills the pool with a wished boulder; do.c boulder_hits_pool() calls bury_objs(), and dig.c bury_an_obj() gives the glob a ROT_ORGANIC timer beside its SHRINK_GLOB. Searching lets mkobj.c shrink_glob() fire on the buried glob. Seed, date, role and inputs chosen independently.
